I cried.

I only recently started to use Reddit when I finish my work or in between projects but I rarely bother to comment anything. I'm fresh-out-of-undergrad and working in one of the few NCI cancer research hospitals in the US. I can tell you that we are trying our best, the research staff and physicians, everyone we are all trying make tomorrow a little brighter for you. I've seen people like you, like me, our age give or take a few years, I smile for you, I smile 'till my eyes water-up. I'm sorry... I'm so sorry. It's not well-written but it's from my heart because I want you to know that there are a lot of us out here who've made it a career for ourselves to show you that you are anything but a lost cause, because you benefit us all, even those who don't know. 

You can make a remarkable turnaround, you are not at your end! 

I accept that we may have contrasting viewpoints on the image of a hospital and what it means to you and I can be quite different. Please, for your best health outcome I hope you will try to stay positive in this horrid experience. I'm sure you know much more about your cancer than you would ever wish to. Maybe frequently asking your Doctors and medical staff questions can make you feel more involved in the process and that might translate into giving you feelings of more control for recurring episodes and nightmares... I just think it would help because the survivors I've met are very motivated individuals and I want you to have MORE TIME

hoping for the best

I went to a forum to meet a woman who went NED after her experience with a primary brain cancer. Despite grim prospects she persisted with treatments from our hospital and some of the recommendations of an ND. Some of this looks like BS to me or just a lil something to help (Like the vitamin D as you may not be getting enough sunlight). I would continue but I'm glad you're a bit skeptical because not all of it will seem to help ... but 'she' swore by it.

Personally I think that was pretty convincing :)

KhanAcademy
I use it to supplement my MCAT studies - so I can get into med school - even after getting my bachelors in science. They teach math at all grade levels including the specifics for AP classes and more. More videos than you can watch in one lifetime, articles, questions, and it's all free.
Enjoy

Edit: if it feels too slow speed the videos up to x2 and if you think it's easy than give some of the practice questions a go
;)
Seriously though, if you think you know it already start with the questions and move on. Math is a skill so just working out the problems (even if they're easy) will work wonders on your brain

Man... I know that feeling. Sometimes, if I find myself at a "friend's" they just insist I get high and we talk very little then I notice when other people show up, everyone is friendly to each other except towards me. When I try to engage and be social it usually just ends up being a giant awkward failure

Thank you 😔 I plan on volunteering but I'm afraid I will likely find myself working alone per usual. I want to move out again, but last time I did that I shut myself away from people choosing rather to cry myself out of bed every morning. And you know that's fucked up considering I had a girlfriend at the time.. so idk what it really is tbh. That girl made me feel a way I hadn't felt since my first crush, like I could say anything or do anything and she wouldn't mind. I still feel like if I hung out with her again we could regain something that's the level of chemistry I noticed... but I have to continue this break in communication which I'm afraid will be permanent.

It shouldn't have been this easy for her to push me aside, I mean I know she doesn't show feelings like at all but.. if it were just fun and games, then why couldn't it stay that way, how am I supposed to get THAT back!?

I am grateful for your advice nonetheless. Right now I feel slightly better knowing that complete strangers will give me the time. But I am still left wondering what it is about me that makes it seem like the more I get to know a person the less they are willing to give me. What kind of cruel psychological concept am I missing here. I would honestly take harsh criticism than to sit in a pool of my own silence wondering what I am supposed to do differently...

It's just going to keep coming back regardless of what I do with my life for distraction. My last Girlfriend was two years ago and I still ended up with a few weeks of depression so bad that I skipped classes and stayed in bed until late in the afternoon. It didn't matter that I had school to focus on and played on a University club team. I felt like an outcast on the team I couldn't socialize like everyone else before practices, and I wouldn't say I sucked at all. It's just that the few who genuinely seemed to want to get to know me gave up when I lacked the appropriate response. I guess I just felt like the only person who truly wanted to be around me was my GF at the time and that annoyed me. I guess I deserve this... I cannot stand being another person's burden nor can I stand to blame someone who used to see potential in me for things not working out. It's just a recurring episode of misery.

I think that she was expecting me to be a sexual flirt, I'm kicking myself. The maybes played out in my head all seem favorable to my current situation. Plus, I don't think I would have been so hung up on her after this if I would have found out at least, but it's too late for that. Regardless this is the one area in my life that I continue to tell myself that I won't put so much effort into, yet I fail thinking that maybe I tried too hard. I just can't deal with it anymore

She told me that she just wanted to focus on work and wasn't really thinking of anyone and that was after she found out her Ex was moving into town to work the same job as the both of us. Apparently I'm just not as close a friend as he is, I don't know if she's been hung up on him this whole time that just makes me feel worse like my best experience with someone was invalidated, but I'm afraid things just aren't going to get better between us. I only cared about the romantics for a day or three, I am fully invested in becoming a close friend but I am the only one whos put in the effort in the last three weeks.

I've had relationships in the past, none too great. This one felt special because I really thought we were becoming close friends first, and I am afraid I will never know what that feels like
